output.headline: Open dental platform route, two prior dental deals and the highest median multiple paid on the priority list make Blackstone a natural add-on buyer.
output.differentiator: Pays the highest median multiple of the buyers profiled (17.1x), with 7 adjacent provider deals, an open platform and capacity for far larger deals than the $80M target. [T:record, A:angles]
output.why_them: Add-on to its open dental platform; pays above-range multiples

acquirer_overview.title: A large sponsor with a ten-year, mostly closed record
points: Financial sponsor with 25 deals from 2015 to 2024; 22 of 25 (88%) closed. [T:record, K:closed_share]
Home sub-sector is Health Insurance (6 deals); median deal is $342M and median EV/EBITDA paid is 17.1x. [B:buyer, K:by_sub_sector, T:record]
Private Equity segment: $416.4 billion of Total Assets Under Management as of December 31, 2025. [P:1]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: An add-on to an open platform, backed by dental and provider deals
points: Platform Build in 9 of 25 deals; its open platform in the sub-sector makes the target an add-on rather than a new bet. [M:platform_build, A:angles]
Deals in this or neighbouring sub-sectors are a modest factor in its likelihood: 2 in dental and 7 in adjacent provider sub-sectors. [S:sector_rel, T:record]
Against: dental is a small share of its deals (a slight factor against) and only 1 deal is in the Southeast. [S:sector_sh

precedent_activity.title: Two dental buyouts in 2021, both at 13.5x
points: Crest Oral Health: $558M leveraged buyout, 2021, 13.5x EV/EBITDA, closed. [D:MA-2021-0164]
North Smile Group: $222M management buyout, 2021, 13.5x, closed. Both dental deals date from 2021. [D:MA-2021-0453]
Adjacent: Evergreen Care Solutions, $299M bolt-on, 2021, 14.6x; Tri Home Health, $75M minority investment, 2022, 14.8x. [D:MA-2021-0195, D:MA-2022-0319]

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible, but the return at the ask falls short
points: Comparable deals (63) span 11.0x at the 25th percentile to 15.4x at the 75th, median 13.7x. [V:comps]
The 75th percentile is defensible: the target's 18.0% margin sits above the comps' median of 12.4%. Blackstone's own median paid is 17.1x. [V:comps]
At 5.0x leverage and 8.5% interest, the equity cheque is $53M and IRR at the ask is 14.0% against a 20% target. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 14.0% is below the 20% target. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 13.7x is available through its open platform. [V:lbo, A:angles]
risk_flags.reality: Maximum price is $68M on either exit, below the $80M EV. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Size stretch
risk_flags.concern: Median deal is $342M; only 5 of 25 deals fall in the $40M-$160M comparable band. [T:record, K:size_band]
risk_flags.mitigant: Smallest deal is $10M, and deal size is a slight factor in its favour. [T:record, S:not_smaller]
risk_flags.reality: The target is small for Blackstone; it fits only as an add-on. [T:record, A:angles]

risk_flags.title: Thin dental and Southeast record
risk_flags.concern: Only 2 dental deals and 1 Southeast deal; 16 deals are outside provider services. [T:record]
risk_flags.mitigant: 7 adjacent provider deals and an open platform in the sub-sector. [T:record, A:angles]
risk_flags.reality: Sector focus is a slight factor against its likelihood. [S:sector_share]

conviction.rationale: Basis: 2 deals in the target's own sub-sector and 7 in adjacent provider sub-sectors, plus an open platform in the sub-sector (add-on route). Offsetting this, the return at the ask is below target. [C:conviction, V:lbo]
